metadata.name: target_fps
metadata.description: the frame rate the governor AIMS for (host-set knob). The achievable rate (clock.fps) falls below this when the device can't keep up.

metadata.name: mode
metadata.description: the learn/lock/lose governor: 'learn' folds each frame cost into the cost model; 'lock' freezes the learned model; 'lose' resets it to the latest sample.

metadata.name: cost_ewma
metadata.description: the learned cost model: an exponential moving average (ms) of how long a frame actually takes. Updated by clock.tick in 'learn' mode; frozen in 'lock'; reseeded in 'lose'.

metadata.name: samples
metadata.description: how many frames have been folded into the cost model so far.

metadata.name: interval
metadata.description: GOVERNOR OUTPUT: ms to wait before the next frame, so the achieved period (cost + interval) targets the sustainable rate. The host loop reads this to schedule the next frame.

metadata.name: fps
metadata.description: GOVERNOR OUTPUT: the achievable frame rate given the learned cost (1000 / max(budget, cost_ewma)). An observer cel — reference it in a stats formula and it updates for free each frame.

metadata.name: tick
metadata.description: (state, cost) - the governor STEP. Fold the measured frame cost (ms) into the cost model per clock.mode, write clock.cost_ewma/samples/interval/fps, and return the next interval (ms). Call once per frame after the sim + paint; schedule the next frame with the returned value. Decouples sim/render rate from device capability via a learnable cost model (learn/lock/lose). Replaces hand-rolled setInterval/rAF clock loops.
